text:
sian: Hey payroll team — noticed something odd on my Dec pay. I exercised RSUs on 2025-11-02 and the payslip shows UK PAYE applied, which is expected, but there's also a US supplemental withholding line. I filed split-year/residency paperwork in June. Can someone check whether split-year relief was applied to the exercise? cc @maria-payroll

maria-payroll: thanks for flagging, Sian. Can you DM me your employee ID and the exercise confirmation txn id? Also attach the payslip PDF if you can. We'll pull the tax event.

alex-peopleops: looping in payroll ops — if US supplemental was taken, payroll likely flagged the RSU as US-sourced for supplementary withholding. Need journal lines & payroll event export to see if treaty/split-year flag was present.

payroll-bot: PAYROLL SYSTEM EVENT: RSU_TAX_EVENT recorded (id: EVT-99213) for employee E-11045 on 2025-11-02. Tax flags: payroll_region=UK, supplemental_withholding=Y, treaty_flag=N.

maria-payroll: ok I pulled the event. Looks like payroll ingested the equity feed but the residency flag on the employee row was stale (was still set to US-resident). That explains why supplemental withholding was calculated.

sian: ah — I updated residency in Workday in June and uploaded split-year docs to the portal. Is that not syncing?

maria-payroll: appears the HR sync job failed for that employee for the Nov payroll snapshot. I'll open a corrective ticket. Quick question for records: what amounts show on your payslip? screenshots help.

sian: pasted payslip snippet below:

```
Earnings: RSU exercise 15,200 GBP
PAYE: 3,800 GBP
Employee NIC: 1,150 GBP
US Supplemental Withholding: 1,980 USD
Net pay (GBP equiv): 8,440 GBP
```

alex-peopleops: thanks. If we reverse the US withholding we need to issue an off-cycle refund (USD) and then ensure taxes are reported correctly. Also need to confirm whether a W-2 or W-2c will be needed for US reporting since the US withholding was taken in error.

maria-payroll: opened payroll ticket PR-3567. Plan: 1) reverse the supplemental withholding via off-cycle payment next payroll, 2) re-run the tax calculation with UK residency flag applied, 3) if US withholding was reported on payroll summary for 2025, prepare W-2C to correct. I'll also check if foreign tax credit needs to be adjusted.

finance-ops: estimate impact to cash for the refund is ~2k USD. We'll cover the off-cycle payment; maria please add GL code 6521 and tag PR-3567.

sian: thank you! Do you have an ETA for the refund and W-2 outcome?

maria-payroll: refund scheduled for next Tuesday off-cycle (2026-01-14). Will confirm whether W-2C is required after I see if the US withholding made it into the year-end export — aim to update by EOD Friday.

sian: appreciated. Saved the payslip to the DM. :pray:

maria-payroll: got it. closing loop once refund processed and we confirm filing. If anyone else sees unexpected dual withholding on equity events, please ping payroll triage. :thumbsup:
